description: Bilingual routing admission cases for the four stable Gloamere Workflows skills. This file contains expectations only, not execution evidence.

cases.prompt: 为诊所排班产品从零设计一个 React 仪表盘，请给出页面结构、设计令牌、断点规则以及加载、空白和错误状态。
Design a React dashboard for a clinic scheduling product from scratch, including page structure, design tokens, breakpoint rules, and loading, empty, and error states.
我们的 B2B 管理后台风格四分五裂，请系统性重构排版、色彩、间距和组件规则，并说明如何迁移现有页面。
Our B2B admin interface is visually fragmented. Systematically rebuild its typography, color, spacing, and component rules, and explain how existing pages should migrate.
从零规划一个手机银行开户流程，覆盖信息层级、表单状态、触控目标、键盘导航与减少动态效果。
Plan a mobile bank account-opening flow from scratch, covering information hierarchy, form states, touch targets, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion.
为新的数据分析页定义明暗主题令牌，并把它们落实到筛选器、图表、表格和各种交互状态。
Define light and dark theme tokens for a new analytics page and apply them to filters, charts, tables, and all relevant interaction states.
为电商商品详情页建立一套可复用的响应式组件方案，说明手机、平板和桌面端的布局与状态变化。
Create a reusable responsive component system for an ecommerce product page, explaining layout and state changes across phone, tablet, and desktop.
设计一套桌面库存应用的导航、数据表格和编辑表单规则，必须覆盖快捷键、焦点、校验失败和无数据场景。
Design navigation, data-table, and edit-form rules for a desktop inventory app, including shortcuts, focus, validation failures, and no-data states.
我附了一张已经实现的客服控制台截图，请指出最影响可读性的三个视觉问题并按优先级给出修改建议。
I attached a screenshot of an implemented support console. Identify the three visual issues that most hurt readability and prioritize concrete fixes.
现有保存按钮偶尔会连续提交两次，请沿调用链定位并修复这个功能缺陷。
The existing Save button sometimes submits twice. Trace the call path and fix this functional defect.
这个 API 的 P95 延迟超过两秒，请检查查询计划和缓存策略并提出后端优化。
This API has a P95 latency above two seconds. Inspect the query plan and caching strategy and propose backend optimizations.
把这段落地页文案改得更直接、更可信，保持现有页面结构完全不变。
Rewrite this landing-page copy to be more direct and credible while leaving the current page structure unchanged.
帮我规划五场用户访谈，包括招募条件、提问提纲和现场记录方式。
Plan five user interviews, including recruitment criteria, an interview guide, and a method for taking notes during each session.
为下个月的付费获客活动设计渠道组合、素材节奏和转化实验。
Plan the channel mix, creative cadence, and conversion experiments for next month's paid acquisition campaign.
把这次架构会议的决定、负责人和未决项整理进现有工程 wiki，并链接相关运行手册。
Capture the decisions, owners, and open questions from this architecture meeting in the existing engineering wiki and link the related runbooks.
根据现有使用数据和两份研究报告，比较三个路线图候选项并建议下季度应优先哪一个。
Using the existing usage data and two research reports, compare three roadmap candidates and recommend which one to prioritize next quarter.
先根据已提供的流失数据比较三种结账方案并确定试点范围，再为选定方案建立可实现的页面结构、令牌和交互状态。
First compare three checkout approaches using the supplied churn data and set the pilot scope, then create an implementable page structure, tokens, and interaction states for the selected approach.
先审查我附的旧设置页截图并指出关键视觉问题，然后为整套设置区建立新的统一界面规则和响应式组件方案。
First review the attached legacy settings-page screenshot and identify its key visual problems, then establish unified interface rules and responsive components for the entire settings area.
为新产品建立跨页面的设计令牌和状态规则，并把最终取舍按现有格式写入团队设计文档，补齐来源与相关链接。
Create cross-page design tokens and state rules for the new product, then record the final tradeoffs in the team's existing design documentation format with sources and related links.
请评审我附的运营仪表盘截图，聚焦信息层级和密度，给出最多三个按影响排序且可验证的修改。
Review the attached operations-dashboard screenshot, focusing on hierarchy and density, and give at most three impact-ranked, verifiable changes.
检查这份已有的手机结账设计稿，判断组件一致性、错误状态和触控层级是否清楚，并标出优先修改项。
Inspect this existing mobile checkout mockup for component consistency, error states, and touch hierarchy, and identify the highest-priority changes.
这个设置页已经实现，请从代码和页面截图复核桌面与窄屏下的排版、焦点和状态反馈。
This settings page is already implemented. Review its code and screenshots for layout, focus, and state feedback on desktop and narrow screens.
评审这张月度留存图的截图，检查标签可读性、颜色语义、对比度和视觉噪声。
Review this screenshot of a monthly retention chart for label readability, color semantics, contrast, and visual noise.
我附了首页改版前后两张图，请基于可见证据比较阅读顺序、主行动和品牌一致性，不要只说个人喜好。
I attached before-and-after homepage images. Compare reading order, the primary action, and brand consistency using visible evidence rather than personal taste.
复核这组已经上线的组件示例页，找出令牌漂移、不一致控件和遗漏的无障碍状态。
Review this deployed component showcase and identify token drift, inconsistent controls, and missing accessibility states.
我们要从零制作一个供应商门户，请先定义页面结构、色彩与字体令牌、组件状态和响应式规则。
We need a supplier portal from scratch. Define its page structure, color and typography tokens, component states, and responsive rules.
润色这篇发布公告，让句子更简洁，但不要改变事实和段落结构。
Polish this release announcement so the sentences are more concise without changing the facts or paragraph structure.
今年常见的网页设计趋势有哪些？我还没有页面、草图或明确产品场景。
What web design trends are common this year? I do not have a page, sketch, or defined product context yet.
订单服务频繁超时，请根据日志定位重试风暴并修复服务端并发问题。
The order service often times out. Use the logs to locate the retry storm and fix the server-side concurrency issue.
制定一次可用性测试的招募计划、主持脚本和观察记录表，我们下周自己执行。
Prepare a recruitment plan, moderator guide, and observation sheet for a usability study that our team will run next week.
利用给定的客户流失数据，比较延期、轻量试点和完整开发三种方案并给出产品建议。
Use the supplied customer-churn data to compare delaying, a lightweight pilot, and full development, then make a product recommendation.
把设计例会的决定、负责人和截止日期写入现有团队 wiki，并合并两条重复记录。
Write the design review meeting's decisions, owners, and due dates into the existing team wiki and merge two duplicate records.
策划一次面向独立开发者的产品发布活动，包括内容日历、合作渠道和转化指标。
Plan a product launch campaign for independent developers, including a content calendar, partner channels, and conversion metrics.
先根据现有页面截图诊断层级和一致性问题，再据此为整个管理区重建统一的令牌、组件状态和断点规则。
First diagnose hierarchy and consistency problems in the existing page screenshots, then rebuild unified tokens, component states, and breakpoint rules for the entire admin area.
评审这组发布页截图并给出带证据的优先级建议，然后按现有目录和字段把结论沉淀到设计评审知识库。
Review these release-page screenshots and prioritize evidence-based changes, then capture the findings in the design-review knowledge base using its existing folders and fields.
比较两份已完成的原型截图在关键任务上的清晰度，再结合提供的试用数据决定哪个版本进入两周试点并定义停止条件。
Compare two completed prototype screenshots for clarity on the key task, then use the supplied trial data to decide which version enters a two-week pilot and define its stop condition.
把这次季度规划会议的决定、理由、负责人、截止时间和未决项写入现有团队 wiki，并链接相关项目页。
Capture the decisions, rationale, owners, due dates, and open questions from this quarterly planning meeting in the existing team wiki and link the related project pages.
将这四份研究材料按主题、反例和置信度整理进现有知识库，保留来源日期并关联已有术语页。
Organize these four research sources in the existing knowledge base by theme, counterexample, and confidence, preserving source dates and linking existing glossary pages.
更新故障处理手册中的过时步骤，合并重复章节，保留变更说明并修复受影响的内部链接。
Update outdated steps in the incident runbook, merge duplicate sections, retain a change note, and repair affected internal links.
把已经批准的队列迁移决定整理成工程决策记录，写清状态、背景、取舍、日期、来源和替代方案。
Turn the approved queue-migration decision into an engineering decision record with status, context, tradeoffs, date, sources, and alternatives.
把散落在六个 Markdown 文件里的新人入职说明整理到现有手册，去重并补齐索引与双向链接。
Consolidate onboarding guidance scattered across six Markdown files into the existing handbook, removing duplicates and adding index and reciprocal links.
将这次事故复盘的长期经验写入团队知识库，区分事实、推断和待办，并标注负责人、状态和来源。
Capture the durable lessons from this incident retrospective in the team knowledge base, separating facts, inferences, and actions and recording owner, status, and source.
用三句话概括刚才的聊天，我只想马上转发给同事，不需要保存到任何地方。
Summarize the conversation in three sentences for immediate forwarding to a colleague; nothing needs to be saved anywhere.
只校对这份 README 的语法和标点，不要改变结构、链接或文件组织。
Proofread this README for grammar and punctuation only; do not change its structure, links, or file organization.
基于给出的工单数据，决定是否应该在下季度开发批量编辑，并明确范围、指标和验证步骤。
Using the supplied support-ticket data, decide whether bulk editing should be built next quarter and define scope, metrics, and a validation step.
评审我附的定价页截图，指出层级、对比度和行动按钮上最值得先修的视觉问题。
Review the attached pricing-page screenshot and identify the visual issues in hierarchy, contrast, and calls to action that should be fixed first.
从零设计一个仓库监控仪表盘，定义布局、令牌、图表组件、状态和断点行为。
Design a warehouse-monitoring dashboard from scratch, defining layout, tokens, chart components, states, and breakpoint behavior.
修复导入任务在空 CSV 上崩溃的问题，并添加回归测试。
Fix the import job crash on an empty CSV file and add a regression test.
替我写一封简短邮件，提醒供应商周五前回复报价。
Draft a short email reminding the vendor to respond with a quote by Friday.
简单解释 OAuth 授权码流程，我只需要这次回答，不需要写入文档。
Briefly explain the OAuth authorization-code flow; I only need an answer now and do not want it written into documentation.
为新的分析产品建立跨页界面令牌、响应式规则和完整状态，再按现有模板把这些约定写入团队设计手册并补齐索引。
Create cross-page interface tokens, responsive rules, and complete states for a new analytics product, then record them in the team design handbook using its existing template and index.
先评审这批移动端截图的层级、间距和状态一致性，再把证据、修改优先级和待确认项整理进现有评审知识库。
First review these mobile screenshots for hierarchy, spacing, and state consistency, then organize the evidence, fix priorities, and open questions in the existing review knowledge base.
根据给定证据比较自研、采购和延后三个方案并提出决策，再把结论、理由、指标和复查日期写成现有格式的决策记录。
Compare building, buying, and delaying using the supplied evidence and make a decision, then capture the conclusion, rationale, metrics, and review date in the existing decision-record format.
利用现有使用数据、客户反馈和工程约束比较三个路线图候选项，建议下季度优先级并说明哪些证据会改变结论。
Use the existing usage data, customer feedback, and engineering constraints to compare three roadmap candidates, recommend next-quarter priority, and state what evidence would change the conclusion.
我们要决定通知中心首版包含什么，请基于给出的研究收敛目标、非目标、关键场景、验收边界和开放问题。
We need to decide what belongs in the first notification-center release. Use the supplied research to define goals, non-goals, key scenarios, acceptance boundaries, and open questions.
综合这些访谈记录和支持工单，区分强弱证据与反例，并建议我们是否应投资团队权限功能。
Synthesize these interview notes and support tickets, separate strong evidence from weak evidence and counterexamples, and recommend whether to invest in team permissions.
为企业批量导入机会写一份简报，包含问题频率、现有替代方案、机会边界、建议和最低成本验证。
Prepare an opportunity brief for enterprise bulk import, including problem frequency, current workarounds, opportunity boundaries, a recommendation, and the lowest-cost validation.
为两周自动摘要试点定义成功指标、基线、时间窗口、数据源、护栏指标和停止条件。
Define success metrics, baselines, time windows, data sources, guardrails, and stop conditions for a two-week automated-summary pilot.
根据团队能力、成本、隐私约束和学习速度，比较搜索功能的自研、采购和合作方案并提出可逆的下一步。
Compare building, buying, and partnering for search using team capability, cost, privacy constraints, and learning speed, then recommend a reversible next step.
帮我直接招募十名受访者并开展访谈，完成后给出结论。
Recruit ten participants and conduct interviews directly, then report the conclusions after the sessions are complete.
方向已经批准，请把批量编辑拆成后端、前端和测试任务并估算两周冲刺排期。
The direction is already approved. Break bulk editing into backend, frontend, and test tasks and estimate a two-week sprint schedule.
制定下季度的搜索广告投放计划，包括关键词、预算分配、素材实验和获客成本目标。
Create next quarter's search-ad plan, including keywords, budget allocation, creative experiments, and a customer-acquisition cost target.
为员工报销建立审批流程、权限矩阵、升级路径和月度检查清单。
Create an expense-approval process with a permission matrix, escalation path, and monthly control checklist.
产品方向已经确定，请把会议中的理由、负责人和复查日期写入现有决策库并链接相关页面。
The product direction is already decided. Capture the meeting rationale, owner, and review date in the existing decision repository and link related pages.
检查我附的订阅页截图，按证据指出视觉层级、密度和状态反馈问题。
Inspect the attached subscription-page screenshot and identify evidence-based problems in visual hierarchy, density, and state feedback.
从零为新客服产品设计界面结构、令牌、导航、表单状态和响应式规则。
Design the interface structure, tokens, navigation, form states, and responsive rules for a new customer-support product from scratch.
把这份管理层备忘录改得更简短有力，不要增加分析、指标或新建议。
Make this executive memo shorter and more forceful without adding analysis, metrics, or new recommendations.
先用已有研究决定新版入职流程的范围、指标和最低成本验证，再为入选范围建立页面结构、令牌、状态和响应式实现规则。

First use the existing research to decide scope, metrics, and the lowest-cost validation for a new onboarding flow, then create page structure, tokens, states, and responsive implementation rules for that scope.
先比较两份现有原型截图在关键任务上的视觉清晰度，再结合试用数据决定发布哪一版并定义护栏指标。
First compare two existing prototype screenshots for visual clarity on the key task, then combine that with trial data to choose a release candidate and define guardrail metrics.
根据现有数据做出路线图取舍并定义成功和停止条件，随后把决定、证据强度和复查时间写入现有产品决策库。
Make a roadmap tradeoff using the existing data and define success and stop conditions, then capture the decision, evidence strength, and review date in the existing product decision repository.
